description: Extract text from all elements matching a selector, joined by a separator. Useful for getting lists of items, table columns, or repeated elements.

attribute.description: Optional attribute to extract instead of text content (e.g., "href", "src").

tab.description: The tab to drive: a handle of this session such as "t2" (list_tabs, new_tab). Default: the session's current tab.

name: extract_all
